doc.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

chapter: The New York band and Charlie Parker
title: Charlie Parker in the band and the Cherokee radio broadcast
summary: Parker was eager to get into the book; the radio broadcast was extended when the station asked them to keep playing.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Was Charlie Parker on that particular group?
Um humm. Yes, yes, the Bird was there. He’s the one who wanted to get in the book so fast.
He wanted to show him something, huh? Was it shortly after that that you did a radio broadcast with him and opened it up with “Cherokee?”
Can you tell me about that, how that worked?
Oh, yeah the guy called down and he says, “can you keep this going a little bit longer?” I says, “yeah.” So we kept it going a little bit longer. That’s just how that happened.
